Photo & Video Booths

Nova Kingdom Rentals offers photo and video booth experiences for weddings, birthdays, graduations, school events, corporate events, and community celebrations across Nova Scotia. Our 360 Video Booth is available now — guests stand on a platform while the camera spins around them for a fun slow-motion 360 video, with an operator and props included. Standalone pricing is $249 for the first hour and $125 each additional hour; as an add-on with any inflatable or package it is $199 for the first hour and $70 each additional hour. A Mirror Photo Booth is coming soon — contact us to be notified when it launches.

Featured Rentals

  • 360 Video Booth - Video Booth, From $249, Dry-use - 360 Video Booth rental for weddings, graduations, birthdays, school events, community events, corporate events, church events, and fundraisers in Nova Scotia.
